title: Homicide team investigates man's death in custody of Abbotsford Police
subtitle: Thirty-seven-year-old Christopher Leslie Kampman died in hospital July 3.
article: ABBOTSFORD, B.C.-Metro Vancouver's integrated homicide unit is investigating the death of a man while in the custody of Abbotsford Police.
Thirty-seven-year-old Christopher Leslie Kampman died in hospital July 3.
Investigators say Abbotsford Police responded to a call about a prowler around 3:30 a.m. on July 1 and located a suspect.
The man was arrested and then taken to hospital in serious condition.
An earlier release from Abbotsford Police said the suspect was combative and making incoherent remarks at the time of his arrest.
The release said an ambulance had already been called and the suspect was waiting, handcuffed in the back of a police cruiser, when he abruptly lost consciousness.
